subject: Oceanography
title: Ocean Pressure
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Ocean Pressure.

hook.text: At the bottom of the Mariana Trench, pressure is 1,000 times greater than at the surface.

buildup.text: Every 10 meters of depth adds one atmosphere of pressure—the weight of the water above.

discovery.text: At 10,000 meters, the pressure would crush a human body instantly—yet animals survive there.

twist.text: Deep-sea creatures have no air spaces in their bodies—pressure passes through them harmlessly.

climax.text: Only three people have visited the deepest point—fewer than have walked on the Moon.

punchline.text: The deep ocean crushes steel—but not the life that evolved there.

quiz.question: How much pressure increases per 10 meters of ocean depth?
